title: USB 2.0 full-speed packet engine in echo mode: NRZI, bit stuffing, SYNC / PID / CRC16 checks on receive, the last good frame sent back after a turnaround

fields.desc: a frame was received in error (SYNC, stuffing, PID check, length, alignment, CRC or EOP); held until reset

irqs.name: ECHO
irqs.desc: a good frame was received (its echo follows)

notes: dp and dm are the full-speed bus pins (tri-state: the engine drives them only while echoing); they pass through unchanged. A bit is 2 x BAUD_DIV = 40 PCLK clocks.
A frame is SYNC, PID, 0 to 8 payload bytes and CRC16; it is echoed after a three-bit turnaround. A frame in error is dropped and the engine waits for 8 bits of idle J.
